subject.title: feat(clickclack): support displayName and subject in resolveDiscussionLabel for human-readable discussion channel names

question: Should ClickClack adopt the linked issue’s title-chain behavior as a narrowly scoped first step, or should discussion naming wait for the broader channel-title, collision, and reconciliation design?
rationale: The linked canonical issue is explicitly labeled as needing maintainer and product review and proposes several related changes; this PR implements only part of that direction.

options.title: Approve the narrow title-chain slice
options.body: After repairing the call sites and adding real ClickClack proof, accept label → displayName → subject as the immediate discussion-name policy.

options.title: Defer to the complete naming design
options.body: Pause this PR until the broader decisions about title generation, collision handling, and reconciliation are specified together.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow title-chain slice
recommendation.body: After repairing the call sites and adding real ClickClack proof, accept label → displayName → subject as the immediate discussion-name policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked canonical issue provides the concrete proposed scope and is the strongest available product-context signal.
